title: Test that every registered route carries an auth decorator or is allowlisted
description: Walk app.url_map at runtime; fail on any endpoint whose view is not wrapped by role_required/login_required and not on an explicit allowlist. See .tasks/auth-decorator-followups.md item 1.

title: PII field registry fails open for non-WHO form types; PII cache never invalidates
description: Fail closed: a form type whose PII set is unconfirmed (no is_pii row on a field the form owns) has whole payload redacted for no-PII viewers and carries a standing admin warning. Cache keyed on max(updated_at)+count of mas_field_display_config. See .tasks/pii-registry-fails-open-for-non-who-forms.md

title: form-options endpoint: per-project tier-2 options for the VA web form
description: GET /api/v1/organization/<project_id>/form-options per docs/policy/va-web-form-options.md. Stores default locale, available locales, narration languages, show_guidance on va_project_master (migration); derives form_types from map_project_site_odk. Intake template stops hardcoding locale='en' and sets the instrument explicitly by form_type_code.
